title: flowguard_review_implementation
description: Submit the independent reviewer's verdict on the recorded implementation (issue #565). reviewVerdict is required. Use at IMPL_REVIEW after the flowguard-reviewer subagent reviewed the implementation recorded by flowguard_implement.

reviewVerdict.description: REQUIRED. The independent reviewer's verdict on the implementation. 'accept' converges the loop and advances to the EVIDENCE_REVIEW user gate; 'changes_requested' requires revision; 'unable_to_review' fails closed and prepares a fresh review attempt.

reviewFindings.description: Structured review findings from independent review (SDK mode only).

reviewerUnavailable.description: Set to true when the reviewer subagent cannot be invoked (fail-closed signal).

ReviewFindings.description: Structured findings from the flowguard-reviewer subagent.
